description: This line plot illustrates the evaluation perplexity of four different model configurations as a function of the activated parameters ratio. The x-axis is labeled "Activated Parameters Ratio(%)" and features a reversed linear scale decreasing from 100 to 25, with tick marks at intervals of 25. The y-axis is labeled "Eval PPL." and uses a linear scale with tick marks ranging from 11.5 to 14.0 at intervals of 0.5, accompanied by horizontal dashed gridlines. The plot contains four lines representing different configurations as indicated by the legend. The "Transformer" configuration is depicted by a red dashed line without markers, which maintains a steady, constant value of approximately 11.6 across the entire x-axis. The "Only MoHD FFN" configuration is shown as a solid grey line with square markers; it begins at approximately 11.4 at an x-value of 100, decreases slightly to a minimum of roughly 11.3 at an x-value of 50, and then rises to end at approximately 11.8 at an x-value of 25. The "Only MoHD ATTN" configuration is represented by a solid dark blue line with circular markers, starting at approximately 11.4 at an x-value of 100 and increasing continuously to reach a peak of approximately 14.3 at an x-value of 25. Finally, the "MoHD ATTN + MLP" configuration is plotted as a solid light blue line with 'x' markers, which starts at approximately 11.4 at an x-value of 100 and increases across the x-axis to end at approximately 13.2 at an x-value of 25.
